items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Delivers the ask: rule linked from CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and writing-plugin.md; Anthropic comparison as a 21-row alignment list; one conventions.json with a skill_authoring section; a report-only checker.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Checker exits 2 on unreadable input, names the searched root, never raises on a missing or odd frontmatter.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Reads local files only; no network, no secrets.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 23 tests, each breaks one limit on a throwaway skill; none reads the real skills.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Tool under shared/scripts/tools, data under shared/config, tests beside the tool; under 300 lines each.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Not wired into CI or verify_local; no plugin skill, constitution or profile touched. The checker reports 155 findings on the current skills, one hard (the compliance description is 1130 characters), left for the conversion work.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No sleeps, no shared state; tmp_path only.
